I told Dana in the #north-team thread that the settled count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 261 seats. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14.

I also pointed out that 185 is a different, older number: the count under Amendment No. 1 in Aug 2025, which Dana had corrected from 180.

I couldn't check 261 against any account files because the file share shows nothing for Quarrendon, so Ilse's post is the only source. I only read #north-team, which Dana belongs to, and a seat count is fine to share with the team.
